PART 1: Combined Synopsis/Solicitation
Title: Notice of Intent to Sole Source – Belt Conveyor [JERED LLC (98523)]
This procurement is using the procedures of 41 U.S.C. 1901, as implemented by Class Deviation
2026-O0028 – Revolutionary Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) Overhaul Part 12, Defense FAR
Supplement (DFARS) Part 212 and Revolutionary FAR Overhaul Part 12.201-1, Simplified
procedures, for acquisition described at 12.001(c), serves as the formal Request for Quotation
(RFQ).
Contact: Russell.Keiser@dla.mil
• RFQ Number: SPE8EF26Q0039
• Description: Purchase of 174 EA of Belt Conveyors, manufactured by Jered LLC (CAGE
98523). Offers are sought from Jered LLC directly, or its authorized distributors/dealers.
• Basis for Award: The award will be made to Jered LLC or an authorized distributor/dealer of its products, based on the most advantageous offer to the Government, considering fair and reasonable pricing. Price reasonableness will be determined in accordance with FAR 13.106-3(a) and DFARS 213.106-3, through comparison of offers received from Jered LLC and/or its authorized distributors/dealers, or other appropriate techniques. Since the requirement is for a sole-source manufactured item, technical acceptability is derived from the product's origin (Jered LLC).

PART 2: Justification and Approval (J&A;) - Attached
Document
Sole Source Justification (FAR 13.106-1(b)(i))
• Requirement: Sole source purchase of Belt Conveyor, manufactured by JERED LLC, to
meet operational needs.
• Authority: FAR 13.106-1(b)(1) - Only one manufacturing source, JERED LLC (CAGE
98523).
• Justification:
Competition: Notice posted to SAM.gov; market research indicates no other items meet
requirements. This procurement is limited to obtaining offers from Jered LLC or its
authorized distributors/dealers.
Key Components of the Combined Notice
• J&A; Reference: The applicable statutory authority permitting Other than Full and Open
Competition is 41 U.S.C. 1901, as implemented by Class Deviation 2026-O0028 –
Revolutionary Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) Overhaul Part 12, Defense FAR
Supplement (DFARS) Part 212 and Revolutionary FAR Overhaul Part 12.102(b) Restricting
Competition.
• Price Evaluation: Offers will be evaluated for fair and reasonable pricing from JERED LLC and/or its authorized distributors/dealers.
• Attachment: The J&A; is attached for transparency.
